{{Top|leg}}
A '''broad-spectrum sensor suite''' was comprised of a [[full-range scanner]], a [[vapro-sampler]], a [[doppraymagno scanner]], and a [[medtox detector]]. The suite was an integral part of [[Athakam Medtech/Legends|Athakam]]/[[Rhinnal State Medical Academy|RSMA's]] [[Bioscan Unit]], providing a comprehensive scan of an individual's [[Species/Legends|species]], sex, height, weight, and vital statistics. Abnormalities, such as [[Disease/Legends|disease]] and infections, were automatically highlighted if found.<ref name="EGWT">''[[The Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref>
